profile_text: With 1,785 employees as of 2024, this audit and accounting firm has experienced a 129.1% growth since its baseline, driven by increasing demand for professional services in the fields of auditing, tax consulting, and financial advisory. Based in Düsseldorf, the company provides a range of services to clients, including financial statement audits, tax planning, and business consulting, leveraging its expertise to support businesses in navigating complex regulatory environments. As a leading player in the professional services sector, the company's growth is fueled by its ability to deliver high-quality services and expertise to its clients.
